LESSON: BELIEF IN PROPHETS 3.3.1 QUALITIES OF PROPHETS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Pillars of Iman
Topic 3.3: Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can qualities of the prophets be applied in daily life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain the qualities of prophets for character formation
2. apply values learnt from the qualities of prophets in their daily lives
3. appreciate belief in Allah’s prophets by emulating the qualities of prophets

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: BELIEF IN PROPHETS 3.3.1 QUALITIES OF PROPHETS
This lesson teaches Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets for Grade 5 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. explain the qualities of prophets for character formation
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. apply values learnt from the qualities of prophets in their daily lives
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate belief in Allah’s prophets by emulating the qualities of prophets
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets above.
2. Explain Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can qualities of the prophets be applied in daily life?
2. Why are prophets regarded as role models?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. explain the qualities of prophets for character formation
2. apply values learnt from the qualities of prophets in their daily lives
3. appreciate belief in Allah’s prophets by emulating the qualities of prophets

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
